variables.description: Columns to look at. Empty means every column.

target.description: Optional target (outcome) column the user cares about. Adds a ranking of the variables most related to it and a regression to start from.

exclude.description: Columns to leave out (e.g. free text, IDs the module would not recognise).

structure.description: Data layout: scale item groups (with Cronbach's alpha and a total column), repeated measures (an ID with several rows), the same measure in several time-point columns.

distributions.description: Distribution shapes: skew, many zeros, floor/ceiling, two peaks, rare or dominant categories.

relations.description: Pairs of variables that go together (Spearman rho for numeric pairs, Cramer's V for categorical pairs), nonlinear, outlier-driven and redundant pairs.

groups.description: Numeric variables that differ between the groups of a categorical variable (eta squared).

missing.description: Missingness of one variable related to the values of another (a MAR clue).

maxHints.description: Number of hint cards. All findings are in the signals table either way.

maxRows.description: Larger data are explored on a random sample of this many rows.

seed.description: Random seed for the sample of rows.

relationMap.description: Heat map of the association strength of every pair.
